resources.string: Ondengel ed saray espisipikon hardware button ya pindoten tan i-remap to iratan ed sananey ya keycode
Say app ya aka-map ed sayan button (%1$s) et ag-aka-install
I-log so kada panpindot na key (parad troubleshoot labat)
Say log remapped button ya pindoten (parad troubleshoot labat)
%1$s start/stop intent auth token (i-paste so interon ‘auth: XXXX’ ya linya manlapud %1$s’s View intents screen)
Iter so %1$s ya permiso, insan i-enable iyan serbisyo ed silong na Accessibility
Tatak na TV (makaapekto ed %1$s TV button ya espisipiko)
